behavioral_notes.observation: Renders the QWeb body_html (related to card.template.body) per target record via mail.render.mixin, then rasterizes it to a JPEG with ir.actions.report._run_wkhtmltoimage at TEMPLATE_DIMENSIONS (600x315, ~2:1 OpenGraph ratio). Dynamic content fields (content_header/section/image paths) are resolved against the record at render time. The image is a generated artifact, not stored design data; _unrestricted_rendering=True trusts the stored body. Not visible in metadata.

card.card is a unique (campaign_id, res_id) mapping = one shareable card per 'sharer'/record. URLs are built by _get_path() using ir.http._slug(self) producing /cards/<slug>/... tokens; card.campaign._update_cards batch-creates and renders missing cards (batches of 100, optional auto_commit). share_status (visited/shared) tracks engagement; _gc_card autovacuum unlinks cards after marketing_card.card_image_cleanup_interval_days (60) since social networks cache images. Not visible in metadata.

Three public http routes. /card.jpg serves the rendered JPEG and, when the visitor user-agent is a social crawler (Facebot, Twitterbot, LinkedInBot, WhatsApp, Pinterest...), flips share_status to 'shared'. /preview renders the share page and marks 'visited'. /redirect returns an OpenGraph meta-tag page (card_campaign_crawler template) to crawlers but redirects humans to the link.tracker short_url / target_url. This crawler-vs-human branching is the social-amplification mechanism. Not visible in metadata.

action_share opens a mailing.mailing prefilled with the campaign, model and a default body embedding the card preview image+link. mailing.mailing is extended so its model is forced to the campaign res_model, recipients are constrained to records that have a card (_get_recipients_domain), and action_put_in_queue/action_send_mail refuse to send while card_requires_sync_count>0 (cards out of date). action_update_cards renders the batch before sending. card.campaign.create auto-provisions a link.tracker (utm source) for click measurement. Not visible in metadata.

No OWL/JS frontend: 0 js files, 0 xml OWL templates, 0 registry adds/patches; only asset bundle web.assets_backend (1). The public-facing surface is server-rendered QWeb (card preview, crawler OpenGraph pages) plus the wkhtmltoimage-rasterized card, not a client OWL app.

information_flows: side-effect: card.campaign._update_cards -> renders card.template body to per-record card.card JPEG (wkhtmltoimage)
side-effect: /card.jpg + /redirect crawler hits -> card.card.share_status shared/visited + link.tracker click counts
side-effect: action_share -> mailing.mailing send constrained to records with synced cards

capabilities: Design Dynamic Share Cards (template + dynamic content)
value_streams: Amplify-Reach: design card -> generate per-recipient cards -> mail to advocates -> advocates share -> crawlers fetch OpenGraph preview -> clicks tracked
policies: _unrestricted_rendering=True: rendering trust delegated to card.template (base.group_system only)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: marketing_card is a value-network (Stabell & Fjeldstad mediation logic): it does not transform inputs into a product (chain) nor match a buyer/seller per case (shop). Its purpose is to mediate and amplify connections between marketing advocates and a wider social audience - it issues a unique per-recipient share card (card.card with a slug token), recipients post it, and the OpenGraph crawler routes serve preview images that pull more viewers in. Value rises with network reach, measured by card_share_count/card_click_count and the link.tracker. It is a support activity for the 3.0 Market and Sell value system (3.4 marketing communications): a promotion/amplification tool, not the primary demand-to-order chain itself. depends on mass_mailing (distribution), link_tracker (UTM/click measurement) and website (public share/preview surface).

standard_capabilities: dynamic share-card templates with static + record-bound dynamic content
per-recipient card generation rasterized to OpenGraph-sized JPEG
public preview/redirect/image routes with social-crawler OpenGraph handling
campaign distribution via mass mailing with card-sync guardrails
typical_fits: event/partner promotion where advocates share a personalized card
campaigns over the hardcoded models (res.partner, event.track, event.booth, event.registration)
post suggestion + reward message + thank-you flow out of the box
common_gaps: supporting a new target model (selection is hardcoded in _get_model_selection)
card layout/design beyond the QWeb template fields and 600x315 ratio
extra social networks (crawler user-agent list is maintained in controller code)
